==================
Whitespace before a double-quoted entity
==================

" &amp;"; following

---

(source (double (double_fragment) (entity)) (identifier))

==================
Whitespace before a single-quoted entity
==================

' &amp;'; following

---

(source (single (single_fragment) (entity)) (identifier))

==================
An entity without a preceding fragment
==================

"&amp;"; following

---

(source (double (entity)) (identifier))

==================
Text before an entity
==================

"text &amp;"; following

---

(source (double (double_fragment) (entity)) (identifier))

==================
A literal ampersand continues the fragment
==================

" &? "; following

---

(source (double (double_fragment)) (identifier))
